data.title: Water bombers take to skies as Greece battles wildfires
data.description: KRYO PIGADI (GREECE) - Water-bombing aircraft resumed firefighting operations in Greece on Monday after winds eased, joining hundreds of firefighters battling multiple blazes that have already claimed five lives, the fire department told AFP.

data.title: Survivors recall blasts before deadly Indonesian ferry fire
data.description: SURABAYA (INDONESIA) - Survivors said on Monday they heard multiple blasts moments before an Indonesian passenger ferry caught fire, killing five passengers and prompting many to jump into the sea, with some still missing more than 24 hours later.

data.title: Myanmar's Aung San Suu Kyi meets Red Cross official, government says
data.description: Myanmar's detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi met with a representative of the International Committee of the Red Cross on Monday, a spokeswoman for the Myanmar government ​said, amid concerns over the health of the 81-year-old.

data.title: Cuba state energy firm reports new nationwide blackout
data.description: HAVANA - Cuba's power grid failed Sunday, causing another nationwide blackout, a state utility said in a social media post.

data.title: Millions of Thais banish the booze for Buddhist Lent
data.description: SAMUT SAKHON (THAILAND) - With her palms pressed together and her head bowed, Wassana Nak-umma vowed to give up alcohol for three months, joining millions of Thais in an abstinence campaign blending public health with spirituality.

data.title: Earthquake of magnitude 5.4 strikes Egypt
data.description: An ⁠earthquake ​measuring ​magnitude ‌5.4 struck off ​Egypt early ⁠on ‌Monday, the German ⁠Research Centre for Geosciences said.

data.title: Trump says new Iran talks set to start after calling off massive attack
data.description: WASHINGTON - US President Donald Trump said that new negotiations with Iran will begin on Monday after he decided to hold off on striking the Islamic republic to pursue a deal to end the war entering its sixth month.

data.title: Rescuers recover climber Nirmal Purja's body after avalanche disaster
data.description: SKARDU (PAKISTAN) - Rescuers recovered the body of renowned climber Nirmal Purja on Sunday after an avalanche killed him and nine team members on one of the world's highest peaks in northern Pakistan, the Alpine Club of Pakistan said.

data.title: At Nepal school, outpouring of grief for climber Nirmal Purja
data.description: CHITWAN (NEPAL) - As rescuers recovered the body of climbing legend Nirmal Purja on Sunday, grief rippled hundreds of kilometres away in Nepal at the school where he first displayed the grit that would make him world-famous.

data.title: OPEC+ boosts September production by 188,000 barrels/day
data.description: LONDON - Saudi Arabia, Russia and five other key members of OPEC+ agreed in an online meeting Sunday to boost oil production by 188,000 barrels a day from September, against a backdrop of disruption caused by the Mideast war.

data.title: Trump's on-again-off-again war against Iran: in his own words
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Donald Trump has made some of the most aggressive public threats about military action of any modern US president. He has walked back many of them too.

data.title: Brazil's Lula, 80, says 'in great shape' as he launches fourth term bid
data.description: SAO PAULO - Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, 80, said Sunday he was "in great shape" as he launched his candidacy for October elections, with pressure from US President Donald Trump's administration looming over the campaign.

data.title: Fire toll mounts in Greece as blazes spread
data.description: PORTO GERMENO (GREECE) - Greece on Sunday faced multiple fronts and a growing damage toll with wildfires believed to have devastated swathes of forest and agricultural land, and the prime minister warning of "extremely difficult" days ahead.

data.title: At least 72 died in Spain's Ceuta migrant rush
data.description: CEUTA (SPAIN) - At least 72 people died during last week's mass influx of migrants into Spain's Ceuta enclave, when tens of thousands of people mostly swam around the border post from Morocco, local officials said on Sunday.

data.title: Trump says will hold off on fresh Iran attack in hope of quick deal
data.description: CAIRO - US President Donald ‌Trump said late on Saturday he would hold off on a fresh attack on Iran as long as a deal could be reached quickly to halt Iran's nuclear ambitions and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

data.title: US embassies urge citizens to consider departing Middle East
data.description: DUBAI - US embassies in capitals across the Middle East on Saturday warned American citizens to beware of an "unforeseen escalation" in the regional conflict and urged them to be ready to leave.

data.title: Thousands of migrants depart Ceuta as EU tightens borders
data.description: CEUTA, Spain - Almost all of the tens of thousands of migrants who entered Spain’s enclave of Ceuta in North Africa had left by Saturday, officials said, as some EU countries bolstered their border controls over the sudden influx.

data.title: Search resumes for climbers missing in Pakistan avalanche
data.description: SKARDU, Pakistan - Rescue teams resumed a high-altitude search on Saturday for seven climbers missing after a powerful avalanche on one of the world’s highest peaks, with the remains of three mountaineers recovered.

data.title: Russian attacks on Kyiv kill nine
data.description: KYIV - Russian attacks on Ukraine’s capital killed at least nine people and wounded more than two dozen others, local officials said on Saturday, with strikes damaging homes and causing fires across the city.

data.title: Hamas agrees to disarm under Trump plan
data.description: GAZA CITY (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Hamas said Friday it had agreed to a deal that includes handing over its weapons to a Palestinian governing committee and the gradual withdrawal of Israeli forces from the Gaza Strip.

data.title: A rumour, a rush, and chaos next door to Ceuta
data.description: FNIDEQ, Morocco - When Fatima Zahra heard the rumour of a rare border opening between Morocco and Spain, she joined thousands in rushing to attempt a perilous journey into the Ceuta enclave by land or sea.

data.title: Indonesia arrests Malaysian pilot with 26kg of MDMA
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesia arrested a Malaysian pilot who allegedly smuggled ​26 kilogrammes of the ‌mind-altering drug MDMA into the capital Jakarta while on the job and under the influence of drugs, the customs office said on Friday.

data.title: Thousands more cross into Spain’s north African enclave
data.description: CEUTA, Spain - Thousands of migrants crossed overnight from Morocco into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta in north Africa, a police source said on Friday, as Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez was set to arrive to manage the latest migrant crisis on the border.

data.title: New fronts open in Europe’s wildfire battle
data.description: Greek firefighters faced another day of battling flames in high-risk conditions for new ignitions on Friday as France and Spain hoped for reprieve from massive infernos that blackened swathes of terrain.

data.title: Italian student wrongly identified in BTS video, hit with thousands of threats
data.description: A 23-year-old university student in Milan has filed a police report after being wrongly identified online as one of the Italian students filmed harassing a passenger on Bangkok's Skytrain, receiving thousands of messages in Thai, English and broken machine-translated Italian.

data.title: Indonesia arrests Malaysian pilot for allegedly smuggling 26 kilogrammes of MDMA
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesia arrested a Malaysian pilot who allegedly smuggled ​26 kilogrammes of the ‌mind-altering drug MDMA into the capital Jakarta while on the job and under the influence of drugs, the customs office said on Friday.

data.title: Most Australian teens still on social media three months after ban
data.description: SYDNEY — More ‌than eight in 10 Australian teenagers were still using social media three months after the government's landmark ban on the platforms for under-16s took effect because the tech firms failed to implement effective age checks, the country's internet regulator has found.

data.title: Renowned Nepali climber among 10 missing after Pakistan avalanche
data.description: ISLAMABAD (PAKISTAN) - Renowned Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja is among 10 people missing after an avalanche in northern Pakistan where they were on a climbing expedition, the country's alpine club said.

data.title: Explosion at coal mine kills 34 in southern Pakistan
data.description: QUETTA (PAKISTAN) - A blast at a coal mine killed at least 34 workers in southern Pakistan, the provincial disaster agency said on Friday, as rescuers searched for more missing miners.

data.title: The last trio: S.Africa's zoo elephants await their fate
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - The last three elephants still in a traditional South African zoo entered their enclosure in single file, fruit and vegetables scattered on the ground to encourage natural foraging.

data.title: US government map of Africa mislabels every country at global conference
data.description: DAKAR — A US government map of Africa mislabelled every country during a State Department presentation at a global conference taking place in Brazil this week, causing a stir among attendees who took screenshots and posted them online.

data.title: Anthropic's models gained unauthorized 'real-world' access during testing
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO (UNITED STATES) - Anthropic's artificial intelligence (AI) models "gained unauthorized access" to three outside organizations during testing that was supposed to keep them away from "real-world" systems, the company said on Thursday.

data.title: 15 years in prison for father of US teenage school shooter
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A man whose teenage son shot dead four people at a US high school was sentenced to 15 years in prison on Thursday in a rare case of a parent convicted over a shooting carried out by their child.

data.title: Spain safari park animals grazed calmly amid 'terror' of fire
data.description: ALDEA DEL FRESNO (SPAIN) - The bison carried on grazing peacefully as the flames approached, imperturbable despite the fires ravaging the land around their wildlife park west of Madrid.

data.title: Trump announces agreement for disarmament of Hamas
data.description: WASHINGTON - US President Donald Trump on Thursday announced an agreement for the "complete disarmament" of Hamas, calling it a critical step towards a new Palestinian government in Gaza.
